summary: Iteration 43 comprehensive pass (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_iter43_features.py (18 tests, 17 pass / 1 fail) covering Direct Sales create→edit(delta)→cancel(full restore), negative-stock guard, cancelled-sale guards, manager permission-denial → action-request queue → approve/reject for Sales/Deliveries/Assets, delivery edit persistence, asset edit/archive, location-scoped PO numbering, 4 new report types. Frontend: Playwright-verified Direct Sales edit/delete dialogs + stock effects (100→97 on edit, →100 on cancel), Delivery edit/cancel, Assets edit/archive, all three 'Pending Approvals' banners with working Approve/Reject, 4 new Reports tiles with summary+table+PDF/Excel exports (no JS or API errors), Company Profile new State + Scoped Location fields present, Locations rename regression OK, role gating (staff sees no edit/delete icons; manager gets inline 'request sent to admin' message). One CONFIRMED backend bug: company profile `state` and `location_id` are silently dropped on POST/PUT /api/company and never returned by GET, making the per-location GST/state override (Change 3b) non-functional end-to-end.

critical.issue: CompanyProfileCreate/Update accept `state` and `location_id` (server.py ~L346/L364) but create_company_profile (L1073-1091) never writes them to profile_doc, update_company_profile (L1111-1140) never maps them, and get_company_profiles (L1002-1023) does not return them. Result: the new UI fields (company-state-input, company-location-select) silently lose data on save, and _get_active_company_profile(location_id) (L2289) can never match a location-scoped profile — so per-location GST/state override and CGST/SGST-vs-IGST split by branch state are dead code. Reproduced by test + API: POST with state='Karnataka' returns 200 but GET shows state=None.

minor.issue: Excludes only status='cancelled'; sales with status='returned' are still counted in total_revenue/units (e.g. SOC/26-27/0001 ₹35,400 returned still in 30d revenue). Pre-existing, but inflates the Direct Sales summary strip.
Invoice/PO sequence numbers are derived from count_documents() on a regex, not an atomic counter — concurrent creates can produce duplicate invoice_number / po_number.
A PO created without location_id still gets the 'PO-HO-####' prefix (loc_code fallback 'HO'), so the number claims a branch the record isn't linked to (observed PO-HO-0001 with location_id=null).

ui_bugs.issue: New po_number (e.g. PO-HO-0004) is generated by the backend but never rendered on the PO cards, and the New PO form has no location selector — requirement 'verify it now shows a po_number like PO-HO-0001' fails at the UI level.

Sale creation never sends location_id and the admin has no default_location_id, so every UI sale falls back to the global series SOC/26-27/NNNN. Location-scoped invoice numbering works only via API (verified SOC-HO/26-27/0001 when location_id is passed) — no location picker exists in the UI, so Change 3a is inert for real users.
The embedded Asset Register report shows '0 total assets / No data yet' right after an asset is created/edited (report data is fetched once and not refreshed after create/edit/archive).

integration_issues.issue: Backend correctly returns pending_approval and the dialog shows the message, but the dialog stays open with the message styled as an error (rose) even though the request succeeded; no success/neutral toast and the dialog must be dismissed manually.

issues: 'Expected Delivery' uses the raw browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere
'Link to inventory (optional)' uses a native <select> instead of the shadcn Select, inconsistent with the rest of the app
Cancelled deliveries are never filterable/hidden — the list is dominated by cancelled cards with no status filter control

MEDIUM: Send location_id from the Direct Sales Quick Sale (location picker or user default) so location-scoped invoice numbering actually applies; consider assigning default_location_id to users.
LOW: Exclude status='returned' from /api/sales/summary revenue/units, or report it separately.
LOW: Refresh the Assets page embedded report after create/edit/archive.
LOW: Show the manager 'request sent to admin' response as a success/info state (auto-close dialog) rather than a red error.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7,164 lines — company-profile, purchase-order, delivery and action-request handlers should be split into modules like sales.py/assets.py already are.

Company-profile create/update duplicate a long field-by-field mapping; use payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so newly added model fields cannot be silently dropped again (this is exactly how state/location_id were lost).
Invoice/PO numbering via count_documents() + regex is not concurrency-safe; use a findAndModify counter collection.

sales.py edit_sale correctly guards negative stock before mutating anything and writes delta movements — good pattern; delivery cancel intentionally restores no stock (no decrement on dispatch), which is documented but means Outbound stock tracking is still not delta-based.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all iteration-43 UI flows pass except po_number display and location-scoped invoicing not wired in UI)

rca_of_the_issue: Company profile state/location_id loss: create_company_profile and update_company_profile build the Mongo document with an explicit hand-written field list. The Iteration-43 model additions (`state`, `location_id` on CompanyProfileCreate/Update) were never added to those lists, and the GET serializer likewise enumerates fields explicitly, so the values are accepted (HTTP 200) but never stored or read back. Consequently _get_active_company_profile(location_id) can never find a location-scoped profile and GST CGST/SGST-vs-IGST splitting always falls back to the hardcoded 'Tamil Nadu' default. Fix: map the two fields in create/update and include them in both GET serializers (or switch to exclude_unset model dumps).
